semiconductor_relevance: High — Azbil provides advanced vacuum gauge technology critical for semiconductor film deposition and etching processes.
summary: Azbil specializes in vacuum gauge technology that addresses challenges in semiconductor film deposition and etching processes. Their innovative sensor designs, including MEMS technology, significantly reduce zero-point shifts caused by gas deposition, enhancing the reliability of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
